children: BMPS reported Q3 2026 net profit of €543 million, up 14.6% year over year and above estimates. It raised FY26 pre-tax profit guidance to over €3.7 billion from €3.6 billion.

BMPS reported €300 billion in total funding and €18 billion in gross wealth inflows for the first nine months of 2026. Gross bad loans were €3.7 billion, or 2.4% of loans; CET1 rose to 16.4%.
